The Best Social Apps for Nights Out in 2026

The group chat does a lot of heavy lifting on a night out. These apps take some of the load: who's out, where to go, what happened and who owes what.

By the ontap team · 27 October 2026
Full disclosure: we make ontap, so it's on this list. We've tried to be fair about what every app does well and where ours isn't the right fit.

Our picks by job

JobApp
See which friends are outontap
Live location for getting homeFind My / Google Maps
Rank the bars you loveBeli
Find a real-ale pub (UK)CAMRA Good Beer Guide
Rate the beerUntappd
Settle up the roundsOur round splitter
Best all-round nights-out app

1. ontap

Log a beer in one tap from a home or lock screen widget, with the bar you're at. See which friends are out on a shared map, race your friends in squads, earn 30+ badges and become Mayor of your local. Every month you get Last Call, a recap worth sharing.

Platforms
iPhone · App Store
Price
Free (an optional ontap Pro is coming)
Best for
Groups of friends who go out together and want logging to take one tap.
Watch out
No beer-by-beer ratings or tasting notes, and no Android app yet.

ontap was built for this: log a beer in one tap, see who's already out on the map, race your friends in squads and get a monthly recap of the nights. It's the thing your group chat was missing.

Best for getting everyone home

2. Find My (Apple)

Apple's built-in location sharing: share where you are with chosen friends or family, indefinitely or for an hour.

Platforms
iPhone (built in)
Price
Free
Best for
Simple, private location sharing with a few close people.
Watch out
No social feed, no venues, nothing beyond a dot on a map.

3. Beli

Rank restaurants, bars, cafés and bakeries by comparing each new place with ones you've already been to. Builds a personal score and recommendations, with friends' lists in a feed.

Platforms
iPhone, Android · Website
Price
Free
Best for
Food-first people who want a ranked list of favourite spots.
Watch out
Built around restaurants; no beer logging, counts or live 'who's out'.

4. Untappd

The best-known beer check-in app: scan or search a specific beer, rate it, add notes and photos, and collect badges. Huge beer database and venue menus from bars that use Untappd for Business.

Platforms
iPhone, Android, web · Website
Price
Free, with an optional paid tier (Untappd Insiders) for extra stats and badges
Best for
Beer geeks who want to rate every individual beer they try.
Watch out
Logging means finding the exact beer each time, which is slow on a night out. Less about seeing which friends are out right now.

5. CAMRA Good Beer Guide app

The Campaign for Real Ale's guide to thousands of UK pubs serving good real ale, with pub details and maps, from the people behind the printed Good Beer Guide.

Platforms
iPhone, Android · Website
Price
Check the App Store for the current price
Best for
Real-ale fans looking for a proper pub anywhere in the UK.
Watch out
UK only and no social or logging features.

One more thing

The best nights-out app is the one your friends actually have. Pick one, get the group on it, and keep the group chat for the memes.
